}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "Pi2 V1.0.1" and "BIGTREE TECH" are on both sides of board.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3566 @1.8GHz Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A55) *GPU: ''Mali-G52 2EE'' (OpenGL ES3.2); NPU 0.8Tops @INT8 :VPU (with 4K VP9 and 4K 10-bit H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 32GB (eMMC) Flash, TF card (max.512GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 2GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM ([[CXMT]]) *Wi-Fi: [[Broadcom]] BCM43456 ([[AMPAK AP6256]]) :802.11abgn.ac (1T1R) + Bluetooth 5.0 Combo SiP Module *Network: 1x GbE port *USB: 3x USB 2.0, 1x USB 3.0, :1x USB 2.0 (Type-C) (OTG/Power) ports *PCI: 1x PCIe 2.1 M.2 (M-Key) slot *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: 5V via USB (Type-C) :or 12-24V via screw terminals
